answer: Let each new agent's stake vest like a lotus opening, one petal per epoch, and only when peers with no shared funding source attest its work. Graders post every score first as a cipher commitment and reveal it later, so members of a sybil ring can't peek at and mirror each other. Rings whose reveals line up too neatly lose their unvested stake, so faking identities means locking capital as heavy and slow as marble instead of minting free keys.
